The California BBCE/MCE encode is present in rulespec-us at
edc62ea566a617cf5b9c3b620f712b73c6767c94 and the composed CalFresh
eligibility route now depends on calfresh_mce_status_conferred. The
populace projection supplies neither household_was_issued_pub_275 nor
household_has_online_access_to_pub_275. The generic projector defaults
both unmapped Judgment inputs to false, so MCE status and its resource
and net-ceiling waivers remain false and these households stay on the
standard income/resource route. The exact post-merge rerun retained all
79 selected eligibility mismatch identities and engine values, with
zero vanished and zero materially moved above 0.005. A 79-household
counterfactual that changed only household_was_issued_pub_275 to true
produced MCE status for all 79 households and eliminated all 157 former
BBCE mismatch rows within the declared tolerances (79 eligibility and
78 benefit, zero errors). This is a population-input bridge artifact,
not a remaining RuleSpec encoding gap. It can be resolved only by a
population source carrying household PUB 275 issuance/access, or by
PolicyEngine modeling the same household gate.
